description.ncbi_summary: The protein encoded by this gene, a member of the peptidase C1 family, is a cysteine proteinase that may have a specific function in the mechanism or regulation of T-cell cytolytic activity. The encoded protein is found associated with the membrane inside the endoplasmic reticulum of natural killer and cytotoxic T-cells. Expression of this gene is up-regulated by interleukin-2. [provided by RefSeq, Jul 2008].

uniprot_function.text: May have a specific function in the mechanism or regulation of T-cell cytolytic activity. (Microbial infection) Plays a role during influenza virus infection in lungs cells ex vivo. Acts at the level of virus entering host cytoplasm from late endosome.
